questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Academic opportunities

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: I wanted to explore Scandinavia since I've studied in 2 out of 3 countries, and Norway was the last country. I also wanted to see Norway's nature.

Additional comments:

questions.answer: Very easy, lots of available information.

questions.answer: No assistance

Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: On campus

questions.question: What options were available for on campus housing? *
questions.answer: I prioritized the price of the rent and close to uni.

questions.question: What options were available for meal plans or cooking facilities? *
questions.answer: Good, we had a big kitchen shared by four.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living in on campus housing? *
questions.answer: It's fun and you have a lot of neighbours

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: a bit confusing since overlapping courses and schedules are normal at Oslo university and I did not really understand at first. There was also a long wait before you knew what courses you were gonna read.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Service desk and webpage

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: I got into the ones I wanted.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: To be aware of the location of some courses because some are at very different locations far away which can be hard to manage together with other courses.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: The level was good, and suitable for both master's and bachelor's students

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: In Norway, it is a lot of work on your own and fewer and shorter lectures, which really suited me and my time during the exchange, because it gives you a lot of free time to explore the city you're in

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 2 semesters

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer: sustainability, marine biology and environmental geology

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your second semester. *
questions.answer: the same as above, you read 30 ECTS parallel the whole time

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Marine biology was fun because Oslo is so specialized in it, which makes the subject very interesting
